Name: Penny - Taller
Author: Jizua
Description:
This mod really just makes Penny 2 pixels taller by increasing her leg and body height 1 pixel each. I always felt Penny looked too short, so when she was teaching the kids she looked like a 16 year old instead of an adult.

I also gave her reading animation on the beach a towel to lay on.

Downloads.Description: Makes Penny taller and gives her a towel on the beach.

Manifest.Name: Penny Taller
Manifest.Description: Change Penny sprites to be taller.
